title: 第9章 凛冬女神的恩赐第10章 幸存者让我用血与铁来和你交流
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
她从营养不良，变成了亚健康状态，但未觉醒状态却变成了待觉醒，也就是说，只要用觉醒水晶催化，菲尔德可以立刻得到一个神选者！
“大人，有什么事吗？”阿诗娜紧张地扒拉小手。
阿诗娜吃了十天的肉排，如今对菲尔德的态度非常好，当她还未被捕捉的时候，日子苦哈哈的，天天找野草吃。如今碰上了这么一个诡异的贵族，反倒天天大鱼大肉。
可能这就是狼生吧，处处是意外。
“这个是？”
“觉醒水晶，花了我六十枚金币的宝物。”菲尔德肉疼，他一共才五百枚金币，“每年的觉醒日，帝国就是拿这玩意来寻找神选者的。”
一个觉醒水晶，能为近千人进行检测。
“啊？您真认为我是神选者？”阿诗娜傻眼，“那个咱别开玩笑了。”
“闭上眼睛，用心感受，我得到过神的指示，你不用担心。”菲尔德胡编乱造，随后将水晶球放在阿诗娜面前。
阿诗娜心里可不认为自己是神选，不过她并不希望让菲尔德失望，这些天的朝夕相处，她觉得菲尔德是个很不一样的贵族，至少对她很好。
双手触碰到水晶球的瞬间，无数蓝色星芒涌出，汇聚出一个优雅清冷的女神虚影。
“掌管冰雪的凛冬女神！”在场的亚人奴隶立刻辨认出来，这本就是他们的信仰，“天呐！阿诗娜居然是凛冬女神的神选者！”
“噗通噗通~”
奴隶们立刻跪倒了一片，激动的浑身颤抖，恨不得献上心脏。
菲尔德也是第一次见这种阵仗，激动得汗流浃背，这可是真正的神迹。
蓝色星芒汇聚出奇特的符文，阿诗娜下意识用手去触碰，光芒逐渐收敛，最后铭刻在阿诗娜的手背之上。
同时，阿诗娜身体也发生了变化，更加高挑，饱满完美的双腿，无可挑剔。肤色欺霜赛雪的女子，神色清冷，猩红的眸子向外透射出冰冷气息，五官比之前更加有致，颜值提高了三成。
强势，轻蔑，魅惑。
媚态浑然天成。
“我居然真成为了神选，大人，您是怎么做到的？”

阿诗娜的小嘴张得浑圆，一副难以置信的神情，她此时对菲尔德充满了敬畏。
要知道，神选者的出现没有丝毫预知的可能，就算是神圣狮鹫帝国的女皇帝，她的女儿也只是普通人。
其余奴隶也不敢置信，明明大家都是奴隶，怎么让领主调教几天，就成为了神选者？阿诗娜这些天的待遇，他们也知道，本以为菲尔德是在调教玩物，没想到真整出神选者了。
神选者，是神的旨意。
奴隶们猜测，菲尔德是神看好之人！顿时对菲尔德也崇拜起来。
“小意思。”菲尔德膨胀地摆摆手，故作低调，随后他大步走到众人面前，“现在，还有谁担忧我们的北境之行，以及抵制我的开拓计划？”
众人面面相觑，谁敢啊？
“相信我，只要你们做好本职工作，完成我的任务，我不仅会还你们自由，还会让你们过上衣食无忧的生活。”菲尔德大声宣布。
“请让我和您签订契约。”
content_en:
She went from being malnourished to a sub-healthy state, but her unawakened state became one waiting to be awakened. In other words, as long as she uses the awakening crystal to catalyze it, Field can immediately get a chosen one!
"Sir, what's the matter?" Asuna nervously tugged at her little hand.
Ashina ate meat steaks for ten days and now has a very good attitude towards Field. When she was not captured, her life was miserable, looking for weeds to eat every day. Now that I have met such a strange nobleman, I am eating and drinking every day.
Maybe this is the birth of a wolf, there are surprises everywhere.
"This is?"
"The Awakening Crystal is a treasure that cost me sixty gold coins." Field's heart ached. He only had five hundred gold coins in total. "On the Awakening Day every year, the empire uses this thing to find the Chosen One."
An awakening crystal can test nearly a thousand people.
"Ah? Do you really think I am the Chosen One?" Asuna was dumbfounded, "Let's not joke about that."
"Close your eyes and feel with your heart. I have received instructions from God. Don't worry." Field made up nonsense and then placed the crystal ball in front of Asuna.
Ashina didn't think she was the chosen one, but she didn't want to disappoint Field. After getting along with him day and night these days, she felt that Field was a very different aristocrat, who was at least very kind to her.
The moment his hands touched the crystal ball, countless blue stars poured out, converging into an elegant and cold shadow of the goddess.
"The Goddess of Winter who is in charge of ice and snow!" The demi-human slaves present immediately recognized that this was their belief. "Oh my God! Ashina is actually the chosen one of the Goddess of Winter!"
"Puff thump thump~"
The slaves immediately fell to their knees, trembling with excitement, wishing they could offer their hearts.
It was also the first time for Field to see such a battle, and he was so excited that he was sweating profusely. This was a real miracle.
The blue stars gathered into strange runes, and Asuna subconsciously touched them with her hands. The light gradually converged, and finally they were engraved on the back of Asuna's hands.
At the same time, Asuna's body has also changed. She is taller, with plump and perfect legs, impeccable. The woman with a fair complexion has a cold look, and her scarlet eyes exude a cold aura. Her facial features are more refined than before, and her appearance has improved by 30%.
Powerful, contemptuous, charming.
Charm is natural.
"I actually became the chosen one. Sir, how did you do it?"
Asheina's little mouth opened wide with an expression of disbelief. She was full of awe of Field at this time.
You must know that there is no possibility of predicting the appearance of the Chosen One. Even the empress of the Holy Griffin Empire, her daughter is just an ordinary person.
The other slaves couldn't believe it. They were all slaves. How could they be trained by the lord for a few days and become the Chosen One? They also knew about Asheena's treatment these days. They thought Field was training a plaything, but they didn't expect that the Chosen One would actually be trained.
The chosen one is God’s will.
The slaves guessed that Field was God's favored man! I immediately admired Field.
"It's not a big deal." Field waved his hands in an inflated manner, pretending to be low-key, and then he strode forward in front of everyone, "Now, who else is worried about our trip to the north and resistance to my development plan?"
Everyone looked at each other, who dared?
"Believe me, as long as you do your job well and complete my tasks, I will not only return your freedom, but also let you live a life without worries about food and clothing." Field announced loudly.
"Please let me sign a contract with you."
